entries.back_en: The endless sea of mud,/to the edge of the world/it goes/Vast and deep, over the/world like a crown,/So large it swallows/even the setting sun.
entries.note: 'brown' rendido como 'barro' (mud/clay); muda cor->lama, embora combine com 'Sea of Mud'.

entries.back_en: The sun rises and sets,/and so the days pass us by,/What is a life,/but the blink of an eye?
All things have an end,/All falls with time into dust/Be it beast, flower or man,/All to time's embrace we surrender
From the world's dawning to its end,/The Eternal open the way/You who hear their call,/Abandon yourselves to fate, and surrender yourselves to all
"It means that when the dragons move, the world follows. Everything the dragons do changes the world in some way... And you all were caught up in that change..."
entries.note: 'vos todos foram' deveria ser 'fostes' p/ concordar com 'vos'; deslize de pessoa.

entries.back_en: From the world's dawning to its end,/The Eternal open the way/You who hear their call,/Abandon yourselves to fate, and surrender yourselves to all

"I... am Ni Ryong. From the depths of the Sea of Mud, I watch over this world. I hear the earth speaking in her dreams, and I guide the boundaries of the lands. Tell me, young Yorae Dragon... Do you need my strength?" Help me!/Not now
"So be it... Let us then stand witness to the fate of the world together..."
"So be it... I shall continue my vigil... Alone..."
"Another awaits your coming... In the land called Shikk, surrounded by trees. If you seek the dragon, seek there..."
entries.note: Fiel; ponto final virou reticencias, irrelevante.
